title: Overwatch
description: Schema for the MEDIATE Overwatch entity. An Overwatch represents a registry-managed component supervising a set of Sentinels and maintaining operational and security status information.

type.description: NGSI-LD entity type. It has to be overwatch.

operationalStatus.description: Property. Current operational status of the Overwatch.

securityStatus.description: Property. Current security status or security level associated with the Overwatch. Example: AMBER.

registeredSentinels.description: Property. Number of Sentinels registered under this Overwatch.

sentinelsUnderThreat.description: Property. Number of Sentinels currently under threat for this Overwatch.

lastHeartbeat.description: Property. Date and time of the latest heartbeat associated with this Overwatch.

managedSentinels.description: Relationship. List of Sentinel entities managed by this Overwatch.

registrationTimestamp.description: Property. Date and time at which the Overwatch was registered in the Service Manager registry.
